en: Color printed postcard showing a hilltop baroque pilgrimage church complex surrounded by green fields and scattered houses, with distant low mountains under a blue sky. At the bottom is the printed German caption "Gruss aus Maria Trost b. Graz," and there is cursive handwriting across the borders and sky area. Along the left edge is the printer's imprint mentioning Karl Braun & Co., München.
